# LGD Eval — Agent Skill Trust & Evaluation

> Independent, evidence-graded evaluation of AI agent skills. We publish reproducible
> comparisons, fail-closed gate results, and public evaluation artifacts. Not affiliated
> with any vendor.

## What this site is

Same-sample comparison of agent-skill scanners and gates (NVIDIA SkillSpector, Snyk Agent
Scan, Cisco DefenseClaw, Arize Phoenix, SkillGate, LGD-Eval), with reproducible commands
and NV marked honestly.

## Key resources

- **Canonical skills registry (187 packages):** https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skills-index/
- **Registry v0 (evaluated assets):** https://lgd-eval.github.io/competitor-comparison/registry.json

- Comparison page: https://lgd-eval.github.io/competitor-comparison/
- R04 five-value validator (public, runnable): https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/fg-tida-r04-contrib/R04_demo_5values_v2.html
- SkillGate (MIT gate): https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/skillgate
- Evaluation account: https://github.com/LGD-Eval
- Papers / DOIs: https://orcid.org/0009-0001-0512-1237
- ClawHub publisher: https://clawhub.ai/zhaoxinghua09-cell

## Evidence policy

- E0–E4 evidence grades; NV never written as pass.
- Fail-closed: missing evidence means not-passed.
- Red-team families: dynamic execution, command execution, deserialization,
  network exfiltration, prompt injection, clean control.
